spec_gaps.description: The production daemon composition root does not exist as a shipped artifact yet; this plan's oracle builds it once in the test (pool + router + readiness + watcher + sync-guard + MCP tools/call routing) and drives the real shim over a real socket. When the shipped daemon lands, this oracle becomes the check that the shipped wiring matches the in-test wiring.
